metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2022 · Moon Knight
metas.description: Steven Grant discovers he's been granted the powers of an Egyptian moon god. But he soon finds out that these newfound powers can be both a blessing and a curse to his troubled life.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2021 · The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
metas.description: Following the events of 'Avengers: Endgame,' Sam Wilson/Falcon and Bucky Barnes/Winter Soldier team up in a global adventure that tests their abilities -- and their patience.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2022 · Obi-Wan Kenobi
metas.description: Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi must save young Leia after she is kidnapped, all the while being pursued by Imperial Inquisitors and his former Padawan now known as Darth Vader.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2021 · Hawkeye
metas.description: Clint Barton aka Hawkeye has the mission to get back to his family for Christmas. But when a threat from his past shows up, Hawkeye reluctantly teams up with Kate Bishop, a skilled archer and his biggest fan, to unravel a conspiracy.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2021 · The Book of Boba Fett
metas.description: Bounty hunter Boba Fett and mercenary Fennec Shand navigate the underworld when they return to Tatooine to claim Jabba the Hutt's old turf.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2024 · 3 Body Problem
metas.description: A fateful decision made in 1960s China reverberates in the present, where a group of scientists partner with a detective to confront an existential planetary threat.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2021 · The Wheel of Time
metas.description: The lives of five young villagers change forever when a strange and powerful woman arrives, claiming one of them is the child of an ancient prophecy with the power to tip the balance between Light and Dark forever.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2021 · What If...?
metas.description: Exploring pivotal moments from the Marvel Cinematic Universe and turning them on their head, leading the audience into uncharted territory.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2023 · Ahsoka
metas.description: After the fall of the Galactic Empire, former Jedi Ahsoka Tano investigates an emerging threat to a vulnerable galaxy.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2021 · Shadow and Bone
metas.description: Dark forces conspire against orphan mapmaker Alina Starkov when she unleashes an extraordinary power that could change the fate of her war-torn world.
Multinational immigrants traveling from the old continent to the new encounter a nightmarish riddle aboard a second ship adrift on the open sea.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2020 · Outer Banks
metas.description: On North Carolina's Outer Banks, a tight-knit group of working-class teenagers known as the Pogues embark on dangerous treasure hunts, uncovering buried secrets, family mysteries, romance, and rivalries while fighting to stay toge...

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2022 · Halo
metas.description: With the galaxy on the brink of destruction, Master Chief John-117 leads his team of Spartans against the alien threat known as the Covenant.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2020 · Star Trek: Picard
metas.description: Follow-up to Star Trek: The Next Generation (1987) that centers on Jean-Luc Picard in the next chapter of his life.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2024 · Agatha All Along
metas.description: A spell-bound Agatha Harkness regains freedom thanks to a teen's help. Intrigued by his plea, she embarks on the Witches' Road trials to reclaim her powers and discover the teen's motivations.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2024 · Avatar: The Last Airbender
metas.description: A young boy known as the Avatar must master the four elemental powers to save the world, and fight against an enemy bent on stopping him.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2022 · Vikings: Valhalla
metas.description: Follow-up series to 'Vikings' set 100 years later and focusing on the adventures of Leif Erikson, Freydis, Harald Hardrada, and the Norman King William the Conqueror.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2024 · Dune: Prophecy
metas.description: Two Harkonnen sisters combat forces that threaten the future of humankind and establish the fabled sect that will become known as the Bene Gesserit.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2022 · The Recruit
metas.description: Owen Hendricks, a CIA lawyer becomes involved in massive international conflicts with dangerous parties after an asset tries to expose her relationship to the agency.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2023 · Monarch: Legacy of Monsters
metas.description: Set after the battle between Godzilla and the Titans, revealing that monsters are real, follows one family's journey to uncover its buried secrets and a legacy linking them to Monarch.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2023 · Percy Jackson and the Olympians
metas.description: Demigod Percy Jackson leads a quest across America to prevent a war among the Olympian gods.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2024 · Skeleton Crew
metas.description: Four kids make a mysterious discovery on their home planet that leads them to get lost in a strange and dangerous galaxy.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2021 · Station Eleven
metas.description: A post apocalyptic saga spanning multiple timelines, telling the stories of survivors of a devastating flu as they attempt to rebuild and reimagine the world anew while holding on to the best of what's been lost.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2026 · The Boroughs
metas.description: In a seemingly picturesque retirement community, a group of unlikely heroes must band together to stop an otherworldly threat from stealing the one thing they don't have - time.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · The Ba***ds of Bollywood
metas.description: An entertaining ride through the adventures of an ambitious outsider navigating the glitzy yet tricky world of Bollywood, with self-aware humor, cameos, and larger-than-life characters for a tongue-in-cheek take on Indian cinema.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2026 · Wonder Man
metas.description: Small-time actor Simon Williams struggles to reckon with his personal life while hiding his super-powers as he tries to land his dream role. Meanwhile, a shady government agent leverages a new friendship in order to save his own job.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2023 · Twisted Metal
metas.description: An outsider must deliver a mysterious package across a post-apocalyptic wasteland in exchange for a better life.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2025 · The Eternaut
metas.description: Follows Juan Salvo along with a group of survivors as they battle an alien threat that is under the direction of an invisible force after a horrific snowfall claims the lives of millions of people.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2023 · The Walking Dead: Dead City
metas.description: Maggie and Negan travel into a post-apocalyptic Manhattan long ago cut off from the mainland. The city is filled with the dead and denizens who have made New York City their own world.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · Young Sherlock
metas.description: A disgraced, young Sherlock Holmes finds himself wrapped up in a murder case that threatens his liberty. His first ever case unravels a globe-trotting conspiracy, culminating in an explosive showdown that changes his life forever.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · Devil May Cry
metas.description: When a mysterious villain threatens to open the gates of Hell, a devilishly handsome demon hunter could be the world's best hope for salvation.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2020 · Barbarians
metas.description: Torn between the mighty empire that raised him and his own tribal people, a Roman officer's conflicted allegiances lead to an epic historical clash.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2024 · Secret Level
metas.description: Original stories set within the worlds of iconic video games are featured in this animated anthology series.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2023 · Lockwood & Co.
metas.description: Lucy, a girl with psychic abilities, joins two boys, Anthony and George, at the ghost-hunting agency Lockwood and Co. to fight the deadly spirits plaguing London, doing their best to save the day without any adult supervision.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2020 · Blood of Zeus
metas.description: A commoner living in ancient Greece, Heron discovers his true heritage as a son of Zeus, and his purpose: to save the world from a demonic army.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2021 · Star Wars: Visions
metas.description: An anthology of animated shorts from around the world celebrating the mythology of Star Wars through unique cultural perspectives.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2020 · The Wilds
metas.description: A group of teens must survive after a plane crash leaves them stranded on a deserted island. The girls tell their stories to investigators who slowly piece together what happened to them.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2022 · Night Sky
metas.description: Follows Franklin and Irene York, a couple who years ago discovered a chamber buried in their backyard which inexplicably leads to a strange, deserted planet.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2025 · Marvel Zombies
metas.description: After the Avengers are overtaken by a zombie plague, a group of survivors discover the key to bringing an end to the super-powered undead, racing across a dystopian landscape and risking their lives to save their world.
